MORE:
In terms of Regulation 30 & 33 of SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirement) Regulations, 2015, this is to inform that the meeting of the Board of Directors of M/s. Dhanlaxmi Cotex Limited was held today on 12th November, 2026, Thursday at registered office at 285, Chatrabhuj Jivandas House, 2nd Floor, Princess Street, Mumbai - Maharashtra - 400002 at 03.00 p.m. and concluded at around 04.25 p.m. The Board has interalia, considered, approved and taken on record as follows:

 1. The Unaudited Standalone Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September, 2026 along with Limited Review Report thereon pursuant to Regulation 33 of SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015.

2. Took note on Compliances made under SEBI (LODR) Regulation, 2015 for the quarter ended 30th September 2026.
